services.name: Evening Cruises
services.desc: Thinking about renting a boat out of Kelowna? Try one of our 1.5 hour Okanagan Lake afternoon cruises and let our experienced crew show you the lake in style. Kelowna Cruises offers daily lunch and afternoon cruises through the months of July and August. All cruises leave from 230 Queensway Ave downtown Kelowna, close to City Park and the Kelowna Yacht Club. Kelowna Cruises is home to two event cruise and tour boats, The Boardroom and The Lake Lounge on Okanagan. These vessels are the only Transport Canada and Kelowna Fire Department fully inspected passenger boats on Okanagan Lake. blurb: Kelowna Cruises offers public afternoon, evening, and late night cruises on two customized houseboats on Okanagan Lake. They also provide charters for weddings, stags, dinners, corporate events, and other celebrations. The boats have capacities of 70 and 85 passengers and feature in-house food and beverage service with various menus.
